mood: Professional, formal, trustworthy, historical but efficient. Avoids generic SaaS looks.

headings.usage: Page titles, institutional headers on receipts, main dashboard numbers.

body.usage: Data tables, forms, sidebar, general UI text. Ensures high legibility for accounting.

hierarchy.h4: text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.15em] text-[#636369] font-sans font-semibold

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: High density for tables (accounting context), generous padding for page layouts. 'Control Room' pattern.
layout_and_spacing.surface_treatment: Flat backgrounds, sharp edges (rounded-sm maximum, 4px), 1px solid border (#E5E2DC). NO heavy soft shadows. Use shadow-sm for popovers/dropdowns only.

components.buttons: rounded-sm px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors. Primary uses #7A2035 text-white hover:bg-[#5C1727].
components.inputs: rounded-sm border-[#E5E2DC] bg-[#FFFFFF] text-sm focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#7A2035]/20 focus:border-[#7A2035]
components.tables: Dense. text-sm. border-collapse. border-b border-[#E5E2DC] on every row. Header row bg-[#FDFBF7] text-[#636369].

login.layout: Split screen. Left: Form. Right: Image background.

receipt_printable.layout: A4 proportion simulation in UI (w-[800px] max-w-full). Pure white bg.
receipt_printable.header_text: Universidad Mayor, Real y Pontificia de San Francisco Xavier\nFacultad de Medicina - Administración
receipt_printable.typography: Cormorant Garamond for header/titles, IBM Plex Sans for tabular payment data.
receipt_printable.border: 1px dashed border around the printable area to indicate it's a receipt document.

images.description: University heraldic crest. Use in Sidebar header and Printable Receipt top.
Colonial university architecture. Use on the right half of the Login screen.

icons.style: Regular weight, 20px for sidebar, 16px for inline actions.

interactions.hover: Background darkens slightly, text color remains high contrast.
interactions.focus: 2px ring using primary color at 20% opacity.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for text. Test text over primary background.
accessibility.testing_attributes: Add data-testid to ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, table rows, tabs, dialog triggers).

tech_stack_instructions.shadcn_customizations: Override rounded-md/rounded-lg to rounded-sm. Strip complex shadows. Use sharp, institutional aesthetics.
